findings.detail: Priority 1 recommendation on contrast ratio lacks a specific CSS selector or page reference.
Priority 2 recommendation on heading hierarchy skips levels but does not specify which headings or pages to target.
Priority 3 recommendation to add a <main> landmark is generic and not tied to any specific element or page.
Priority 4 recommendation on semantic structure replaces landmarks with semantic elements but provides no selector, ID, or page context.
Priority 6 recommendation to add missing Schema.org properties references only generic entity types without specific property names or pages.
Priority 7 recommendation mirrors Priority 6 and is similarly non‑specific.
Recommendation to declare intended audience with a machine‑readable signal lacks any page, selector, or data anchor.
Recommendation to expose age‑assurance signal does not reference a specific element, page, or selector.
Recommendation to surface consent signal is generic and not tied to a particular element or page.
General recommendation to add full MX fields, governance, and provenance metadata lacks any concrete data anchor from the audit.
Optional enhancement suggestion for Content‑Signal directives does not reference specific elements, pages, or data points.
